purpose: Discoverable non-secret registry. Checked-in manifests are the declared-permission source of truth; this registry never proves live installation state.

source_of_truth_policy.secret_values: never collect, serialize, log, or upload

apps.purpose: Read-only collection, quota readings, feed collection, evidence harvest
promotion_gates: Verify active installation and repository scope using installation-authenticated evidence.
Verify active permission grants separately from manifest declarations.
Instrument token-mint outcome, API status counts, rate-limit remaining/reset, and collector run identity without recording credentials.
Prove a real collector batch uses the app token and does not consume the PAT bucket.
Pass negative-path tests for missing credentials, revoked installation, inaccessible repository, and permission drift.
